We need to extract atomic claims. Let's parse.

Text about history.

Sentences:

1. "After an uprising by the Congolese people, Belgium surrendered to the independence of the Congo in 1960."

Claims:
- There was an uprising by the Congolese people. (event)
- Belgium surrendered to the independence of the Congo in 1960. Means Belgium recognized Congo independence in 1960. Claim: Belgium surrendered to the independence of the Congo in 1960. Could be "Belgium recognized independence of the Congo in 1960". We'll phrase: Belgium surrendered to the independence of the Congo in 1960. We'll treat as "Belgium surrendered to the independence of the Congo" with point in time 1960.

2. "However, the Congo remained unstable because tribal leaders had more power than the central government."

Claims:
- The Congo remained unstable. (state)
- Tribal leaders had more power than the central government. (power relation)

3. "Prime Minister Patrice Lumumba tried to restore order with the aid of the Soviet Union as part of the Cold War, causing the United States to support a coup led by Colonel Joseph Mobutu in 1965."

Claims:
- Patrice Lumumba was Prime Minister. (role)
- Patrice Lumumba tried to restore order with the aid of the Soviet Union. (action)
- This was as part of the Cold War. (context)
- The United States supported a coup led by Colonel Joseph Mobutu in 1965. (US support)
- The coup was led by Colonel Joseph Mobutu. (leadership)
- The coup occurred in 1965. (date)

4. "Mobutu quickly seized complete power of the Congo and renamed the country Zaire."

Claims:
- Mobutu seized complete power of the Congo. (action)
- Mobutu renamed the country Zaire. (renaming)

5. "He sought to Africanize the country, changing his own name to Mobutu Sese Seko, and demanded that African citizens change their Western names to traditional African names."

Claims:
- Mobutu sought to Africanize the country. (goal)
- Mobutu changed his own name to Mobutu Sese Seko. (name change)
- Mobutu demanded that African citizens change their Western names to traditional African names. (demand)

6. "Mobutu sought to repress any opposition to his rule, in which he successfully did throughout the 1980s."

Claims:
- Mobutu sought to repress any opposition to his rule. (goal)
- Mobutu successfully repressed opposition throughout the 1980s. (action with time)

7. "However, with his regime weakened in the 1990s, Mobutu was forced to agree to a power - sharing government with the opposition party."

Claims:
- Mobutu's regime was weakened in the 1990s. (state)
- Moboux was forced to agree to a power-sharing government with the opposition party. (event)

8. "Mobutu remained the head of state and promised elections within the next two years that never took place."

Claims:
- Mobutu remained head of state. (position)
- Mobutu promised elections within the next two years. (promise)
- The promised elections never took place. (negated outcome)
